source_verification: All 24 original bindings in both registrations authenticated before implementation. Read Tong original acquired text lines 4694-4742,5290-5308,5957-5968 and QE commutator_Hx_psi.f90 lines 77-81,110-129,185-212. Runtime reauthenticates these bindings. Existing retained UPF quadrature and Peierls family are reused, not a new pseudopotential or DFT calculation.
scalar: E_total=N*[sum_s w_s Tr(rho_s (H0_A25_s+DeltaV0_s))+dv/2 delta_n.K.delta_n+u.(sum_s w_s Tr(rho_s (g_A25_s+Delta_g_s))+Gheld-FII-Fsupport)+u.(C_common+Delta_C_prepared).u/2+a.sum_s w_s Tr(rho_s L_physical_s)+a.C_field_prepared.a/2+u.T_prepared.a+sum_atom (P-Z*a)^2/(2 M_Ry)]+Pi^2/(2 M_Maxwell). rho_s=Psi_s D_s Psi_s^dagger with fixed original complex D; w_s=1/N for each independent full-grid spin/mesh sector; N=64. No extra spin factor. Base electronic held sector must be empty or its optical/zero-field coefficients supplied separately; this implementation requires empty held sector.
derivation: DeltaV0=V_UPF(0)-V_A25(0), Delta_g=d_u DeltaV0, Delta_C_prepared=Tr(rho_prepared d_u d_v DeltaV0). H0_A25 and K retained; zero-field physical correction is not discarded/anchored. g_A25+Delta_g is the electronic ionic vertex. Physical L=d_a[(p+a)^2+V_UPF(a)] at a=0. C_field_prepared=Tr(rho_prepared d_a d_b H_UPF). All second-coordinate coefficients fixed at prepared density.

b(p,a,u)=exp(-i*p.(tau+u))*b_center(p+a). Using exp(-i*(p+a).(tau+u)) instead is an atom-channel common scalar phase cancelling in b d b^dagger and ALL four mixed product terms. b_u=-i*p_u*b, b_a=exp(-ip.tau)*d_a b_center, b_ua=-i*p_u*b_a. Mixed V_ua=b_ua d b^dagger+b_u d b_a^dagger+b_a d b_u^dagger+b d b_ua^dagger. T_atom,u,a=Tr(D Psi^dagger V_ua Psi). Kinetic/local mixed derivatives are zero at fixed plane-wave frame. No derivative of rho is included in direct T; electronic response remains in the evolving rho.

New overlaps X_b,X_a[3],X_u[3],X_ua[9] require 16*nh columns per atom. Existing 29-jet receipts contain final scalar moments, not these overlaps, and cannot supply T. Explicit extra all-original-source full-row/full-column contractions are mandatory. Cost O(P*Nband*16*sum_atom nh), no kinetic P*Nband^2 pass needed, no PW-square operator, no local FFT.

Derivative equations: i Psi_dot=(H0_A25+DeltaV0+V_K+u.(g_A25+Delta_g)+a.L)Psi. u_dot=(P-Z*a)/M_Ry; P_dot=FII+Fsupport-Gheld-<g_A25+Delta_g>-(C_common+Delta_C)u-T*a. a_dot=Pi/M_Maxwell; Pi_dot=-N*[<L>+C_field*a+T^T*u-sum_atom Z*(P-Z*a)/M_Ry]. Electronic charge current_Ha=-N*(<L>+C_field*a+T^T*u)/2; ionic current_Ha=N*sum Z*u_dot/2. Current density divides by N*cell_volume. Mean ionic Poisson bracket is 1/N; per-slot electronic bracket is 1/(N*w_s); field bracket is 1. Thus all equations derive from total E, not mixed per-cell/total energies.

The polynomial omits delta_rho*u*u, delta_rho*a*a, delta_rho*u*a and higher total orders. They are not zero physically. Nonlinear rho representation and K are retained as in PreparedReference; this is its joint quadratic effective scalar, not a nonlinear all-field UPF model or exact gauge covariance of the truncated polynomial.

Units: numeric a=e*a0*A_SI/hbar, tau=t*Ry/hbar, E_Ha=E_SI/(2Ry/(e*a0))=-a_dot/2. eps0*(Omega*a0^3)*E_SI^2/(2Ry)=Omega*a_dot^2/(16pi), using Ry=e^2/(8pi eps0 a0), so M_Maxwell=Omega/(8pi), Omega=64*abs(det(cell)). Ion SI kinetic gives M_Ry=m*a0^2*Ry/hbar^2=m/(2me). P-Z*a is mandatory for positive original UPF valence Z; no nominal/oxidation charge substitution.

T transport under the explicitly declared geometric approximation is T_target[atom]=R T_source[pullback(atom)] R^T; rotationally scalar channel d is verified. Every slot weighted once; no H0 symmetry transport assertion. Actual H0 total energy/drift still requires actual full-slot electronic evaluation, not the source-weighted diagnostic energy.
field_preparation: Conditional centered sudden-release Gaussian, independent tensor product with the actual electronic and ionic prepared states. Clamp rho,u,P at their initial means, retain ionic diamagnetic stiffness: K=N*(C_field+sum Z^2/M_Ry*I), projected to supplied orthonormal polarizations. Only strictly positive real symmetric K permits covariance Vqq=K^(-1/2)/(2 sqrt(M)), Vpp=sqrt(M)*K^(1/2)/2, ordered qp=+iI/2. Linear current force is NOT canceled; center zero is a preparation hypothesis, not the ground state of the affine clamped scalar or coupled equilibrium. Nonpositive stiffness reports missing explicit external preparation/trap or supplied normalizable field state, never clipping. T couples released variables; product Gaussian is not coupled ground state. Existing ionic Gaussian remains unchanged, not re-prepared with new curvature.
oracle: SymPy exact SI/Ry conversion and total scalar Hamilton derivatives with mean Poisson normalization
independent dense complex-frame mixed four-leg jets and field/ionic vertex traces
phase-gauge equivalence, non-real Hermitian D and general complex ordered D, omitted mixed leg/conjugation/phase/current/ion charge sign sensitivities
full scalar dense finite differences including electronic frame derivative, zero-field correction, fixed-contact omission and fixed mixed derivatives
strict positive Gaussian uncertainty and nonpositive rejection
product_energy_accounting: At zero product means the field covariance adds Tr(K Vqq)/2+Tr(Vpp)/(2M)=sum omega/2, including electronic and ionic diamagnetic stiffness exactly once. Independent local ionic covariance from the actual preparation adds N*Tr(DeltaC Vuu_local)/2 to the unanchored mean correction. Mixed u-a and P-a means vanish by the product hypothesis. These are corrections to the existing scalar expectation, not a fabricated absolute H0 energy; no electronic fluctuation kernel is reinterpreted as propagated noise.
scope: Uniform q0 field only; original full 4^3 matter grid does not create finite-q photons. Finite BvK volume is neither external sample/cavity nor irreversible bath. No propagated noise, trajectories, material rates, equilibrium or full E/D completion. No new DFT, scientific runs or tests by worker.
